interpretation.name: CalibrateSharedNutrunnerBeforeLine2Use
interpretation.goal: Calibrate the shared nutrunner NR7 before line 2 uses it to tighten the fasteners of variant F30.
constraints: Calibration of NR7 must be completed before any tightening of variant F30 fasteners on line 2
No calibration service is available in this Local Cloud, so no calibration Step can be planned and no service may be invented for it
No tightening for line 2 may be scheduled in place of the missing calibration, because that would bypass the operator's precondition
Any later use of NR7 must hold a reservation and must be evaluated and recorded as required by E1, E5 and E6
interpretation.horizon: Applies once, before line 2's next use of NR7 for variant F30

findings.message: requested capabilities not exposed by the Local Cloud: ['calibrate-tool (nutrunner calibration)']
